correctness.rationale: Reflect the unit-weight cycle about the pendant vertex. The odd sector has sine eigenpairs with nonzero e1 coordinate; the even sector is irreducible symmetric tridiagonal, hence simple. Even and odd eigenvalues cannot collide by projecting the forced cycle equation onto cosine and using the leaf equation. A controllability-invisible even eigenvector satisfies v1=v_(n-1)=0 and a Dirichlet recurrence with odd ell, lambda=2-2cos(pi ell/(n-2)); boundary equations force lambda^2-2(1+t)lambda+2t=0, giving positive t exactly at specified eligible ell. PBH converts this complete list to rank deficiency, at most 2. Special t=1 and 1/2 congruences follow from angles pi/4,3pi/4 and pi/5,3pi/5. Independent exact rational Krylov matrix rank for 50 cases n=3..12 and 5 positive weights agrees; it is not the infinite proof.
